dsp GenBlownPanWindyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.07 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.06 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.02 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6490

dsp GenBlownPanWindyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.07 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.06 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.02 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6500

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.04)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.1 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.06 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6880

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0

    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))

    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))

    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b

  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0

  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0

    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)

    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b

    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.03 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.01 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6889

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.03 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.01 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6770

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.03 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.01 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6514

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0

    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)

    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.03 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.01 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6474

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.02 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.0 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6909

  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0

  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0

    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.08 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.04 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6889

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.08 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.04 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6753

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.08 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.04 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6461

dsp GenBlownFifePureLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.25 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.15 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6630

dsp GenBlownFifePureHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.25 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.15 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6742

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.25 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.15 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6495

dsp GenBlownFifeWindyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.25 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.15 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6350

dsp GenReedClarinetSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 2.0 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4857

dsp GenReedClarinetSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 2.0 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4856

dsp GenReedClarinetReedyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 3.2 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4590

dsp GenReedClarinetReedyVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 3.2 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4590

dsp GenReedClarinetBrassyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 4.8 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4393

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 2.0 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4857

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 3.2 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0

    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)

    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))

    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l

dsp GenReedChalumeauBrassyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := (softsign(sinpi(phA * 2.0) * (1.0 + 4.8 * envA * (0.4 + colour)))) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 6.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l) * 1.3) * 0.4393

dsp GenReedOboeSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1400.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.6) * 1.3) * 0.4946

dsp GenReedOboeSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1400.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.6) * 1.3) * 0.4922

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1400.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.6) * 1.3) * 0.4908

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1400.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.6) * 1.3) * 0.4892

reedSaxReedyStill.source:
dsp GenReedSaxReedyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 900.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.4) * 1.3) * 0.4784
